findings.issue: Overgeneralized grammar claim: 会う does not ALWAYS take に for the person met; 〜と会う is fully grammatical and common (mutual meeting). The absolute 'always' teaches learners that と会う is wrong.
findings.current: The verb 会う always uses the particle に for the person one meets.
findings.suggested: The verb 会う typically takes the particle に for the person one meets (と is also possible).

findings.issue: Same overgeneralization as expl_en: 'sempre usa a partícula に' is false — 会う also takes と (encontro mútuo). Absolutes like this mislead learners.
findings.current: O verbo 会う sempre usa a partícula に para a pessoa que se encontra.
findings.suggested: O verbo 会う normalmente usa a partícula に para a pessoa que se encontra (と também é possível).

findings.issue: 'was getting dry' reads かわいていた as progressive, which the expl_en itself explicitly denies (it teaches the resultative-state reading 'was dry'). The literal field contradicts the grammar point being taught.
findings.current: As for his throat, it was getting dry (was in a state of dryness).
findings.suggested: As for his throat, it was dry (was in the state resulting from having dried).

findings.issue: 'estava secando' is the progressive reading of かわいていた, exactly the misreading expl_pt warns against ('não significa estar secando agora'). Literal must show the resultative state.
findings.current: Dele garganta-quanto-a estava secando (estava no estado de seca).
findings.suggested: Dele garganta-quanto-a estava seca (no estado resultante de ter secado).

findings.issue: Literal mistranslates the structure: 来る前に is a subordinate temporal clause 'before you come', but 'You come first; we'll go on ahead' renders it as two coordinate/imperative-like clauses and loses 前に entirely; てしまう is also not mirrored.
findings.current: You come first; we'll go on ahead, you know.
findings.suggested: Before you [が] come, we [は] will have gone (off for good), you know.

findings.issue: Stray duplicate tokens: list begins with 私 and たち (all fields null) before あなた, duplicating the correct 私たち token at its proper position; reconstructing the sentence from tokens yields 私たちあなたが来る前に私たちは… Delete tokens[0]-[1].
findings.current: tokens[0]=私, tokens[1]=たち (all-null), placed before あなた
findings.suggested: Remove stray tokens[0] and tokens[1]; 私たち already appears correctly later in the list

findings.issue: 'up to two hours or more' is self-contradictory and mistranslates emphatic も, which stresses the large amount ('as much/long as'), not an upper limit ('up to'). The expl correctly says も marks surprising length, so the literal contradicts it.
findings.current: As for me, I waited up to two hours or more.
findings.suggested: As for me, I waited as much as two hours or more.
